newsitem.title: CHINA: China yuan market turnover down in February.
newsitem.headline: China yuan market turnover down in February.

text.p: China's local currency interbank market traded 27.7 billion yuan in February, sharply down from 64.1 billion yuan in January, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday, quoting exchange figures.
The plunge was mainly due to the long Chinese lunar new year holiday in early February, the newspaper said.
The seven-day and 30-day contracts were the most active in February, it said. The market also trades contracts of one day, 20, 60, 90 and 120 days duration.
The weighted average interest rate of the seven contracts fell 0.037 percentage points to 11.58 percent in February, the newspaper said.
